currentRoundInspection.scope: Three principal pictures guide overall/portal form;one extra hospital capital close view was inspected. A west-mosque gate page was identified by its category and not used as a hospital reference. No bespoke surveys or redistributed images.

pictures.author: Dosseman /Dick Osseman
pictures.observed: Actually inspected1280×868 overall elevated northwestern view. Adjoining low stone mosque/hospital,stepped grey metal hipped roofs,tall eight-sided main stone pyramid and smaller tomb cone,two low roof lanterns,north raised carved portal and cylindrical minaret on a large rounded corner buttress. Caption warns of historical/restoration and color-edit differences;current condition is not claimed.

pictures.author: Dosseman /Dick Osseman
pictures.observed: Actually inspected500×744 oblique north-portal detail. Deep stepped stone doorway,large clustered columns with flared faceted capitals,broad geometric bands,rosettes and high-relief vegetal forms. Model uses original broad geometric/leaf abstractions;fine carvings and inscriptions are not copied or claimed accurate.

pictures.author: Mxcil
pictures.observed: Actually inspected500×667 hospital entrance:monumental nested pointed arch,large side shafts/flared capitals,upper recessed rectangular opening with central column,two round medallions,star-like tympanum relief and lower doorway under a broad protective timber roof. Fine relief and lettering are abstracted. A separate2014 capital close view by R Prazeres was also inspected but adds no dimensional control.
